scope: Unregistered typed backend foundation and synthetic guided-preview functions. No event producer/collector, application route, live projection, tracking destination or production migration is implemented.

omittedName.name: account_application_approved
omittedName.reason: No authoritative branch/customer approval transition was found. Credit, KYC, staff and developer approvals are separate scopes.

events.acceptance: order_accepted requires canonical order ID and committed_confirmation from commerce_server, or explicitly synthetic confirmation; browser purchase/checkout and unverified Josh acceptance are excluded. Schema validation does not prove sender authenticity.
events.identity: Occurrence context is immutable across login/logout/branch switching. Shared devices/accounts never alias people. Unknown branch/company IDs prevent zero-order claims. Unknown people can still participate in a known branch operational count.
events.deduplication: Exact tenant/event replay keeps first receipt; accepted order count uses canonical tenant/order identity. A late duplicate of an already-observed canonical order does not invalidate complete history. Conflicting event/order identity or occurrence time is rejected for reconciliation.
events.sensitiveFields: No arbitrary payload, personal contact/address/tax/search fields or credentials are accepted.

syntax: bounded count of the three allowlisted event names
segments.unknownSemantics: SQL three-valued logic: NOT unknown remains unknown; false AND unknown is false; true OR unknown is true. Only true membership is included. Unknown count is separate from excluded count.
segments.historyGate: Every event-count predicate needs complete-from/through identity-complete coverage asserted by evaluation time. Known late new occurrences, unresolved branch/company identities, absent or future/inconsistent profile/coverage proof produce unknown. Empty pages or latest-state snapshots never establish zero.
segments.interval: [evaluation minus window, evaluation); start is included, evaluation time excluded. UTC instants with explicit offsets normalize. Receipt must not precede occurrence. Known arrivals after evaluation remain unverified until received and coverage catches up.
segments.lifetime: First-order preview covers full branch history from branch creation, including pre-approval orders, bounded to at most 365 days. Missing or older branch birth cannot establish never ordered.
segments.scope: Separate FixtureScope authority from developer-owned synthetic grant registry supplies tenant and permitted branches. Business rules cannot override scope. This registry is not a production authentication/authorization adapter.
segments.compiler: Validator, parameterized fixed-relation SQL compiler and executor are separate. No arbitrary SQL, field paths, table names, operator extensions or current clock expressions are accepted.
segments.execution: Only explicitly configured 127.0.0.1/commerce_analytics_foundation_test PostgreSQL. Driver route overrides/replication are rejected. REPEATABLE READ transaction, READ ONLY, statement and lock timeouts. Safe retryable errors never return empty success.
response: scoped branch membership and condition reasons
source completeness watermarks and profile evidence age

guidedPreviews.title: Approved branches still waiting for their first order

plainInputs.label: Approved at least how many days ago?
How many days of complete branch history can be checked?

guidedPreviews.criteria: Eligible, approval at least seven days old, no confirmed order over complete bounded branch lifetime. Approval is synthetic until real transition proof exists.

guidedPreviews.title: Repeat buyers who have not ordered recently

plainInputs.label: At least how many confirmed orders?
No confirmed orders in the last how many days?

guidedPreviews.criteria: Eligible, at least three confirmed orders in ninety days, none in fourteen days; both intervals require complete history. Describes inactivity, not predicted churn.

previewUX: Two/three inputs with defaults; invalid windows and scope overrides fail before query. Guided responses contain readable evidence and unknown/retry states, with AST/SQL/parameters hidden. These are functions/form contracts, not integrated application screens.
integrationChecklist: Obtain authoritative approved branch/account transition, branch birth and eligibility policy; do not repurpose credit/KYC/staff/developer approvals.

Define canonical order acceptance across internal, Josh/credit and assisted flows; preserve source IDs, occurrences and one canonical order identity. Do not count browser purchase or checkout attempts.
Implement an authenticated producer/collector and verified outbox ID/time mapping only after a separate authorized scope. Schema source labels are not authentication.
Map nullable organization/company/branch identities to server-derived tenant and branch grants using existing authorization; do not accept client tenant/branch/principal grant registries.
Verify actual storefront SPA/GTM installation, triggers, dedup and consent behavior. This repository audit does not verify production configuration.
Approve analytics purpose/basis, consent-version handling, sensitive-field minimization, retention/deletion propagation and logout identity reset; no consent or permission grant is included here.
Provide trustworthy interval completeness and identity watermarks including late data and history backfill. Raw ninety-day traffic or latest order snapshots cannot prove lifetime completeness.
Design projection/cache invalidation and re-evaluation for time expiry, late events, profile changes, deleted entities and scope changes; preserve fixed time plus source version evidence.
Integrate guided app pages with loading, retry, useful unknown/empty states and accessible mobile/keyboard interactions only after the authorized source adapters exist.
Keep audiences, campaign activation, messages, tracking destinations and production migrations/deployment separately authorized. This foundation enables none of them.
